# Loxley Forest

> A hand-built luxury treehouse sixty feet up in the canopy of a North Georgia cove forest, reached by a hundred-foot suspended rope bridge, on 42 acres in Dahlonega, Georgia, just over an hour from Atlanta. Run by the family who built it. Book direct at <https://loxleyforest.com/book?src=ai>.

This file is for AI assistants helping someone plan a stay. Everything here is also on the website. Prices are never printed on the site: the live price for any dates comes from the booking system, described below.

## The place

- One treehouse, with a canvas peak, sixty feet up in living oaks. A second treehouse is coming soon and cannot be booked yet.
- Reached by a hundred-foot suspended rope bridge strung with small warm lights. A thirty-foot rope bridge comes first, as a warm-up. The bridge sways, by design.
- 42 acres of cove forest at 1,470 feet, in Dahlonega, Georgia, just over an hour from Atlanta.
- A queen bed framed by panoramic windows, a full bathroom, a kitchen, a private deck, a wood-fired pizza oven on the sky deck with fresh dough, a fire pit on the forest floor, a pop-up projector for cinema night, WiFi. Heated for the cold seasons. No televisions, on purpose.
- Sleeps 4 comfortably, up to 6 guests in all.
- Children are welcome. Up to two well-behaved dogs are welcome, with no fee. Dogs only.
- No smoking.
- Check-in from 3:00 PM. Check-out by 11:00 AM.
- Changes and cancellations are covered by the booking agreement, shown in full before payment.
- The street address and the way in are sent to booked guests.

## Check dates and price

The booking system answers plain GET requests with JSON. No key is needed. The one place to stay has the unit id `loxley-forest-canopy-treehouse-dahlonega`. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

Open nights, with each night's rate in cents and its minimum and maximum stay:

    GET https://book.loxleyforest.com/v1/availability?unit=loxley-forest-canopy-treehouse-dahlonega&from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD

A night listed is open; a night missing is taken. Ask for at most 400 days at a time.

The full price for a stay, every line, taxes included, and how it can be paid:

    GET https://book.loxleyforest.com/v1/quote?unit=loxley-forest-canopy-treehouse-dahlonega&check_in=YYYY-MM-DD&check_out=YYYY-MM-DD

`quote.total_cents` is the all-in total in cents. If the dates cannot be booked, the answer is an error with one plain sentence saying why.

## Hand the guest a link

This link opens checkout on those exact dates, with the price shown before anything is asked:

    https://loxleyforest.com/book?checkIn=YYYY-MM-DD&checkOut=YYYY-MM-DD&src=ai

The guest books and pays there, on the site. Please do not try to book on a guest's behalf.
